messages:
Alex P: Hey infra — trying to embed Service Overview + Model Health dashboards into the Central Ops Confluence page for the central-inference cluster. I can open Confluence but when I click the Grafana shortlink I get a 403. Anyone know which group I need or can share a shortlink that works for read-only?
Maria S: Which link are you using? Grafana RBAC is org/team based. Best is to use the share -> link short URL (g/x...).
Alex P: The exact URL I used: https://grafana.company.com/d/abcd123/central-service-overview?orgId=1 — hits 403. I'm in group `eng-infra` — thought that would be enough. Maybe need `platform-obsv-ro` or similar?
Kevin L: You need the `eng-observability-read` role. Just added you to that group (should propagate in ~2m). If it still 403 after that ping me and I can check the audit logs.
observability-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-OBS-874 — Grant grafana read to Alex P. Assigned: Kevin L.
Alex P: Thanks. Quick follow-up: is there a pinned shortlink that's iframe-friendly for Confluence embeds? We want live panels, not snapshots if possible.
Maria S: We don't allow anonymous/public embeds by policy. Options: 1) Snapshot (Share -> Snapshot) — works in Confluence but is static. 2) App account + token via infra-iam and a proxy that Confluence can call (needs security sign-off).
Kevin L: If you need live embed, open a security ticket to whitelist Confluence origin + request an app account. I can escalate. Also try this solo panel link which is usually iframe-friendly once you have read perms: https://grafana.company.com/d-solo/efgh456/central-service-overview?orgId=1&panelId=2&kiosk
Alex P: Retried after the group add — panel loads now, no 403. Confirmed the panel shows model-health tiles. Kevin — can you add a short note on the Confluence page about the auth steps and how to request access for other teams?
observability-bot: INFRA-OBS-874 updated: status -> resolved (permissions applied).
Kevin L: Done — added a short how-to and the request template on the Confluence page. :thumbsup:
